title: Audio-Language Models — Qwen2.5-Omni, Audio Flamingo, GPT-4o Audio

questions.question: How many feature frames does fake_audio_encoder(audio_seconds=3.0) return?
questions.explanation: The encoder uses int(audio_seconds*50), giving 150 frames for three seconds.

questions.question: What shape does projector(features[:8]) produce with the default dimensions?
questions.explanation: The projector preserves the number of feature rows and maps audio_dim 1280 to llm_dim 4096.

questions.question: How does interleave_with_text combine its arguments in this toy?
options: All AUDIO tuples first, followed by all TEXT tuples
It alternates one audio and one text item at every position
It drops text tokens when audio is present
It concatenates the values without type labels
questions.explanation: The return expression creates the AUDIO list and then appends the TEXT list; despite the name, it does not alternate them.

questions.question: What does fake_llm_answer count in an interleaved sequence?
options: The sum of all numeric token IDs
The number of AUDIO items and TEXT items by their type labels
The sample rate encoded in each audio frame
Only the final text token
questions.explanation: It sums items whose first tuple element is AUDIO or TEXT and reports both counts.

questions.question: Which three components does the lesson’s Audio-Language Model template connect?
options: STFT, mel filterbank, and DCT without a language model
Vocoder, microphone, and WAV writer only
Audio encoder, projector, and LLM decoder
Speaker verifier, watermark detector, and turn detector
questions.explanation: The skeleton explicitly passes audio representations through a projector into an LLM-style decoder.

questions.question: Why is the projector needed between an audio encoder and an LLM?
options: It performs beam search over the audio vocabulary
It removes all audio time steps before decoding
It converts text tokens into waveform samples
It changes the audio feature width into the embedding width expected by the language model
questions.explanation: The linear map produces 4096-wide vectors from 1280-wide audio features so the two modules share an interface.
